# Loihi2_OnChip_Learning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of Loihi 2's dedicated on-chip learning circuits and synaptic plasticity mechanisms to perform weight updates locally without external training loops. Reduces latency and energy overhead of learning, enabling autonomous and distributed adaptation within the network, central to iNEST's vision.
